newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Memtec buys Italian filter maker.
newsitem.headline: Memtec buys Italian filter maker.

text.p: U.S. and Australian listed water filtration group Memtec Ltd has bought Italian filter cartridge and filter housing manufacturer, Vessel srl, for US$3 million in cash, Memtec said on Thursday.
Vessel is a Milan-based company selling its products into various markets in Italy.
"Key markets for Vessel include the automotive paints market, the chemical process markets, the reverse osmosis pre-treatment market and the food and beverage markets," Memtec said.
Vessel's current management would stay with the company, Memtec said.
Memtec's ADRs closed unchanged at US$23 in the United States on Wednesday and Memtec's Australian shares closed up 97 cents at A$30.02.
